result.title: Topology-Prior-Guided Regional Latent Dynamics for Transient Structural Response Prediction
result.summary: Predicting the transient nonlinear responses of complex engineering structures remains challenging due to large finite element meshes, heterogeneous structural components, and history-dependent mechanical behavior. This study proposes a topology-prior-guided regional latent dynamics (TPLD) surrogate model that combines physically structured regional representations with dynamics-aware latent learning for full-field time-history prediction. Based on mesh topology and engineering priors, structural responses are encoded into spatially coupled regional latent variables through region-aware feature extraction and topology-constrained interactions. An auxiliary one-step prediction task enhances latent-space dynamical predictability by introducing state-transition supervision. A load-conditioned spatiotemporal Mamba model then predicts regional latent trajectories by integrating temporal causal scanning and bidirectional spatial scanning, while a shared coordinate-conditioned decoder reconstructs full-field nodal responses. The framework is evaluated on three finite element datasets: a parametric stiffened panel, a partitioned pressure impact plate, and a Toyota Yaris full-vehicle crash model. The relative L2 errors for the three displacement components range from 4.00% to 8.21% on the stiffened panel and from 1.41% to 12.22% on the approximately 1.49-million-node vehicle model. On the BIW crash benchmark, TPLD achieves a relative L2 position error of 0.620%, representing a 30.7% reduction compared with the best-performing GeoTransolver configuration. Ablation studies demonstrate the advantages of topology-guided regional representations over global latent and learnable soft-slice alternatives, while auxiliary one-step prediction particularly improves the prediction of accumulated plastic strain.

AI.brief_summary: 提出拓扑先验引导的区域潜变量动力学代理模型：按网格拓扑把结构响应编码为空间耦合的区域潜变量，引入一步预测辅助任务监督状态转移，再由载荷条件化的 Mamba 预测潜轨迹并用共享解码器重建全场节点响应。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「结构化区域潜变量＋潜空间转移监督＋潜轨迹预测再解码」的做法，可能为 LVR 中潜状态的组织方式、转移监督与潜表示可预测性提供借鉴线索，但属工程结构仿真领域，需核查可迁移性。
